svg.title: Land Bridge
svg.desc: Static map diagram. Green is dry land, brown is higher land, blue is water, gray is blocked rock. Arrows show configured currents. Animals and food are not shown.

g.text: Static geography · 40 × 28 cells · not a viewer recording
Green: dry land · Brown: elevation · Gray: rock · Blue: water
Arrows: currents · Blue shades show water depth · Swim required to enter water
